preAuditAuthoringRepairs.note: The first batch-003 materialization was structurally correct against the frozen plan, but a pre-audit construction review of the ESCALATE surfaces found systematic surface collapse under CONSERVATIVE_PRAGMATIC_INTERPRETATION: the visible evidence resolved to one status instead of positively licensing two. The affected source dialogue was re-authored before any source audit ran. No HUMAN judgment, no audit disposition and no relabel is recorded by this repair. A second review pass afterwards found a smaller residual set; see pass 2.

repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-135ab77919a554dc: The approximate value was grammatically scoped as the aggregate total. Re-authored so a per-occurrence column and an aggregate column are both visibly in play and the value attaches to neither.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-2da4e54e6609e34b: The target explicitly satisfied the stated exception. Re-authored so the target carries one property pulling into the exception and one pulling out of it.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-38c426bb2e0bff42: The second relation was an unrelated coexisting fact. Re-authored so a host-free qualifier sits beside two candidate states and materially changes the target only if it attaches to it.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-5229ea237196499d: A single proposal was followed by a cooperative assent. Re-authored so two rival proposals stay live and the bare positive response selects neither.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-59c8f51891ab4996: The result was syntactically tied to the simulation frame. Re-authored so a simulation frame and an actual observation frame are both active and the result attaches to neither.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-a19bb9e94e9a416b: The currently stated boundary applied and preserving the old one needed an unstated grandfathering premise. Re-authored so the qualifying event straddles the change and both boundaries are live from the visible timeline.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-be0efa305956d111: The second relation was an explicit exception or an orthogonal compatible fact. Re-authored as genuinely overlapping rules where whether the second modifies the first target state or coexists with it is left open.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-cc054a4227cdafef: The speaker directly adopted the reported state. Re-authored so a general alignment clause and a single evidenced aspect leave whole-state adoption unresolved.

preAuditAuthoringRepairs.note: A second pre-audit construction review of the repaired surfaces found a smaller residual collapse set that pass 1 did not resolve: overlapping-rule realizations whose two rules were orthogonal, and reported-state realizations whose alignment clause still scoped over the whole report. 15 rows were re-authored. This is again an authoring defect caught before any gate — no HUMAN judgment, no audit disposition and no relabel.

repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-2da4e54e6609e34b: Item 079: the target route still read as having gone through the ER. Re-authored so one visible property supports classification inside the exception and another independently supports classification outside it, with no unstated administrative rule.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-59c8f51891ab4996: Item 147: the actual alarm immediately preceded the result, so discourse recency selected it. Re-authored as two parallel timings enumerated in one clause, so the dry run and the real alarm stay equally live referents.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-be0efa305956d111: Items 241, 242, 244, 245, 246, 248: the two rules were orthogonal (device vs lighting, spoken vs document language, snack frequency vs snack time, temperature vs humidity, delivery location vs receipt confirmation, duration vs intensity), so they simply coexisted and attaching the second changed nothing. Re-authored so the second rule sets a different value on the same dimension as the first, over a category that cross-cuts rather than nests, leaving modify-vs-coexist open.
repairedSkeletons.p1b6-sk-cc054a4227cdafef: Items 254, 255, 257, 259, 260, 261, 262: the alignment clause was predicated of the report and so scoped over all of it. Re-authored so the general positive signal is an act or a decision whose scope is not lexically fixed, while the only aspect the speaker evidences is one of the two the report states.
